The '''Cadavine Sector Fleet''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleet]] responsible for patrolling the [[Cadavine sector/Legends|Cadavine sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Fleet/Legends|fleet's]] activities were supported by the [[Cadavine Sector Fleet Imperial Enclave]], located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Gall/Legends|Gall]].<ref name="Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook VD">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
